opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN + GitHub into notes
opportunities.description: For a given project name, find its top Hacker News story, look up the GitHub repo stars and latest release, and save a 'Lead' note.
steps: Search project name on Hacker News (or Algolia HN search)
Note top story title, points, and age
Search project name in GitHub search bar and open top repo
Note star count and last release date
Add a note 'Lead: <name>. HN "<title>" (<pts>, <age>); GitHub <stars> stars, last release <date>' in notes app

opportunities.name: Country fact-check: World Bank + BBC into notes
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up a World Bank indicator and related BBC news, then save a fact-check note.
steps: Search country on World Bank data site
Read indicator such as life expectancy
Search '<country> <topic>' on BBC and open top article
Add a 'Fact-check <country>' note with the indicator and news headline
